Hellín — Madrid, Spain

Average day Average night

In detail

Hellin appears repeatedly alongside neighbouring Amposta and Simancas in coverage of drug-related degradation and uncollected rubbish in the wider Parque Paraiso area, and is named among the district's more vulnerable, lower-income barrios in an October 2025 report on residents having to pay out of pocket for a municipal benefit. It also features in coverage of the Ayuntamiento's Plan Regenera urban-improvement works. The documented concern is moderate and tied to the shared drug/degradation problem of the surrounding streets rather than a distinct, more severe pattern of its own. Sources checked: 20Minutos, 30 Oct 2025 (drug degradation and rubbish, Amposta and Hellin); EL PAIS, 14 Oct 2025 (vulnerable barrios, Amposta/Hellin/Arcos); La Razon, 19 Aug 2026 (Plan Regenera works).
